question: From the given options, which is India's first indigenously built nuclear-armed submarine?
solution:
The answer is__** INS Arihant**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **I****NS Arihant** is the first of the planned five in the class of submarines designed and constructed as a part of the **Indian Navy's secretive Advanced Technology Vessel (ATV) project.**
 
• The ATV project was set up in 1984, under **Vice Admiral Mihir K. Roy** as the first Director General.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **N****erpa(INS Chakra) **is a 8,140-tonne Project 971 nuclear-powered attack submarine. The construction of the submarine was s**tarted in Russia in 1993.**
 
• **INS Khukri **was a Type 14 frigate of the Indian Navy. This was the first warship sunk in action by a submarine since World War II.
 
• NS Kalvari (S21) is the first of the six indigenous **Scorpene-class submarines** currently in service with the Indian Navy. It is a diesel-electric attack submarine which is designed and was manufactured a**t**** Mazagon ****Dock Limited in Mumbai**.
